generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The refactoring of `computeOutput` introduces a regression in functionality for the `Join` class. The previous implementation supported multiple join types (`LEFT`, `RIGHT`, `FULL`, and default), whereas the new implementation throws an `UnsupportedOperationException` for any type other than `LEFT`. While this PR focuses on the `LOOKUP` command (which typically maps to a left join), removing support for other join types in a shared logical plan component may break other parts of the system that rely on these join types.

The `output()` method in `Lookup` now throws an `IllegalStateException` if `localRelation` is null. Previously, it provided a fallback using `Expressions.asAttributes(matchFields)`. This changes the behavior of the logical plan when queried before the relation is resolved. Ensure that this strict requirement for resolution is intended and does not break any existing analysis or optimization passes that might call `output()` on an unresolved node.
